addressed_weaknesses: Incremental value over the estimated rescaling: ran it on every task (Section 4.9) and added a Bayley-Hammersley window (aTDS-BH) found on one benchmark and validated unchanged on held-out data and all other tests (Section 4.8, Table 7): better detection and per-link power than both aTDS and the rescaling; trade-offs reported
False stability above budget near regime boundaries: a one-window boundary margin brings aTDS to 3.8 % (Section 4.12); stated when the rescaling or the first-zero window is preferable
Failure on L0123002 explained: seasonal flow autocorrelation (0.62 at one year) ignored by the first-zero factor -> 3-year window; a 120-day cap recovers the 1-day delay (Section 5.4, Table 10)
Sensitivity to the Bartlett truncation: three estimators compared (Table 7)
Abstract, Discussion and Conclusion rewritten around the validated result and explicit limits
